_readme: This file is data, not code. The app reads it to populate the add-ons dialog and installs
nothing until the user presses Use on an entry. It is not a provider list and it is not
Every entry points a provider id, already known to the engine's own catalogue, at a base URL.
An entry never contains a credential and is not an endorsement, a partnership, or a permission.
Whoever connects an account is responsible for that service's terms, quotas, and usage rules.
